data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Dita was a goddess of the harvest, fertility, and abundance. In the Christian context, Dita represents the gift of God, or the grace and blessings bestowed upon us by Him. The name Dita carries the meaning “God's gift” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Dita usually hope their child will grow to embody god's gift and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dita total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_greek.name: Ντίτα
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Ντίτα είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα που προέρχεται από την εβραϊκή γλώσσα και σημαίνει καλή, όμορφη, αγαπημένη. Στην ελληνική παράδοση, το όνομα Ντίτα συνδέεται με τις έννοιες της ομορφιάς, της αγάπης και της καλοσύνης.
